//: The fake-provider table for the HOLODEX-342 stress fixture (HOLODEX-348).
Data, not code, because THREE things have to agree about it and only one of
them is JavaScript: testdata/enrich-stub/stub.js serves these personas,
testdata/stressseed seeds their values into entity_enrichment so the fixture
boots with a populated chip row, and testdata/stressseed/sources.yaml
registers them with the server. A seeder holding its own copy of these
strings would drift from the stub, and the fixture would then state a value
the page stops rendering the moment anyone hits Refresh — which is the exact
failure the whole addressing scheme exists to prevent.
precedence — ADR-090 layer 2. Values MUST differ between personas: the chip
row folds by value, so five providers that agree render as one
adoption   — ADR-090 layer 1. Candidate-list shapes for EnrichPicker.
fault      — loading and error states, reachable on demand.
icon is an RGB triple the stub renders as a solid PNG, or null for no
brand_icon at all (the ProviderIcon monogram fallback). candidates and fault
